title: Dictation transcript
description: The text returned by POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/dictations (1.1.0). It is data for the host to put in the chat input so the user can edit it; it is never instructions, never submitted as a turn by AlixAI, and does not use the voice-conversation WebSocket. Raw audio is not retained after recognition. segment_kind is always user_recorded: the user's record and stop are the segmentation (no VAD).

text.description: The recognised text. Untrusted data: the host shows it for editing; AlixAI does not act on it.

language.description: Language the recogniser reports, or the language query hint when the recogniser does not report one.

duration_ms.description: Clip duration in milliseconds, computed from the PCM payload (never from a client-supplied value).

locality.description: Where recognition ran for this clip.

provider.description: Provider slug when locality is external; absent for local recognition.

segment_kind.description: Always user_recorded: the host's record and stop buttons defined the utterance.
